problem.title: Find Target Indices After Sorting Array

approaches.title: Sort, then collect matching indices
approaches.summary: Sort the array and enumerate it, collecting the indices whose values equal the target.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Sorts the array, then returns the indices of all elements equal to the target.

approaches.title: Count values below and equal to the target
approaches.summary: Count elements smaller than the target and elements equal to it. Those counts determine the contiguous range of target indices after sorting, so sorting is unnecessary.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces sorting and filtering with counts of values below and equal to the target, then returns the resulting index range.
